question: m15
q: Which of Sydney's commercial centres has the busiest Fridays relative to midweek right now, and which the quietest?

transcript.answer:
**Busiest Friday relative to midweek: Chatswood. Quietest: North Sydney.** These are the latest figures, for September 2026.

| Centre | Friday ÷ Tue–Thu, Sep 2026 |
|---|---|
| Chatswood | 1.03 |
| Strathfield | 1.00 |
| Parramatta | 0.81 |
| Sydney CBD | 0.78 |
| Macquarie Park | 0.77 |
| North Sydney | 0.74 |

Chatswood is the only centre where Friday evening tap-ons exceed the Tue–Thu average. Strathfield is level with midweek. The other four still run well below midweek, so North Sydney's Friday evenings are about 26% quieter than its Tuesday–Thursday evenings.

The ratio is noisy month to month. North Sydney has ranged from 0.69 to 0.76 since October 2025, so it has been the lowest or near-lowest for most of the year. Chatswood peaked at 1.05 in August 2026 and dipped to 0.87 in December 2025.
